title: Lubbock's 1st El Pollo Loco location set to open - NewsBreak
text:
By Urijah Jaushlin ,
6 hours ago
The above video shows the top local headlines for the morning of July 1, 2026.
LUBBOCK, Texas — The first Lubbock location of El-Pollo Loco will be opening its doors sooner than expected.
The new restaurant is slated to open on Monday, July 6, at 7102 Quaker Ave.
Hours of operation are 10:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., seven days a week, with dine-in, drive-thru and takeout available. Third-party delivery and catering services will be introduced in the coming weeks.
Here’s what’s coming to Lubbock: New permits filed second quarter of 2026 “We’re excited to introduce El Pollo Loco to Lubbock and bring guests a new restaurant centered around quality ingredients and fire-grilled chicken,” said co-owner Katie Hughes Mallory. “Having grown up with El Pollo Loco in Southern California and spent nearly two decades serving the Lubbock community through our family’s restaurants, it’s incredibly rewarding to bring a brand we know and believe into West Texas. We believe guests will appreciate the quality and distinctive menu that have made El Pollo Loco a favorite for generations.”
El Pollo Loco is known for its citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken and prepares its food daily using quality ingredients. From its classic chicken meals to burritos, bowls and handcrafted sides, the brand continues to deliver bold, flavorful options that appeal to a wide range of guests.
